# SimplifyTrabaho

> A free, open, automatically updated list of jobs at Philippine companies — all
> roles and levels, with internships and entry-level roles featured. Data comes
> only from public ATS APIs that companies intentionally publish (Greenhouse,
> Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, BambooHR, Breezy, Manatal).
> Every listing links to the company's official application page. No job boards
> are scraped. Refreshed once daily.

Facts stored per listing: company, role title, locations, work setup, level,
function, industry, employer type (direct employer vs staffing/outsourcing
agency), structured salary when published, dates, and the official application
URL. Job-description text is never stored.

## Data

- [Job listings JSON (CC0 1.0)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yanicells/SimplifyTrabaho/main/data/listings.json): the full dataset, schema v3
- [RSS feed](https://simplifytrabaho.ycells.com/feed.xml): newest 100 openings
- [Source repository](https://github.com/yanicells/SimplifyTrabaho): pipeline + site, MIT-licensed code, CC0 data

## Site

- [Job board](https://simplifytrabaho.ycells.com/): filter by level, function, work setup, metro, industry, employer type; shareable URLs use query params (q, level, fn, setup, metro, industry, type, loc)
